claims.statement: `creation_date` is an operational instant (`resultTime`), not the time the observed phenomenon occurred, and must not be used as the time axis of the phenomenon.

claims.statement: `epoch` carries phenomenon time -- when the thing being described happened. Time series, windowing, and joins to other feeds are built on it.
claims.negative: Treating `epoch` as the time the record was produced, received, or published, or using a different member for event time.
